# Keemake

> Keemake is a premium Japanese kitchen knife retailer offering professional-grade chef knives, specialty blades, and culinary tools in VG10 carbon steel.

Keemake specializes in authentic Japanese kitchen knives for both home and commercial use, featuring distinct product lines including the CHANG and DE series. The catalog spans traditional Japanese blade types (Santoku, Nakiri, Deba, Sashimi) as well as Western-style knives (Chef, Utility, Carving, Boning), all crafted with precision for culinary professionals and enthusiasts.
